claude.rationale: gap_45=1: the combination merged complementary product/technology portfolios ("fullstream" upstream/midstream/downstream) but the underlying operational substrate did not transfer or integrate coherently at closing — the slice states the shared substrate was "bridged through a defined package of ancillary agreements executed effective at Closing rather than fully integrated at that moment," and GE-side capability (GE Store, Predix, GE Digital) was accessed via cross-license/services agreements rather than owned. gap_56=1: processes were bridged via Transition/Intercompany Services, supply, and IP/trademark agreements rather than merged, while the organization/people crossed under a mixed governance structure (6 GE/5 BHI board, GE Chairman, GE O&G CEO/CFO installed) with GE holding only ~62.5% and BHI ~37.5% economics — a documented process-vs-organization mismatch. gap_mitigated=yes: both gaps were contractually absorbed at closing via the Transition Services Agreement (later substituted by an Intercompany Services Agreement), Tax Matters, supply, IP Cross-License, Trademark License, GE Digital, and Non-Competition agreements per §7.18.

gemini.rationale: The transaction combined GE O&G and Baker Hughes into a single operating entity (Newco LLC) with a combined 'fullstream' portfolio. Both companies contributed their entire respective product lines, operational processes, and organizations to the new combined entity, meaning no structural mismatch occurred between products and processes (gap_45) or processes and people (gap_56) at closing.

grok.rationale: At closing both GE O&G and Baker Hughes customer-facing portfolios were contributed into Newco LLC as a combined fullstream product set, and the operating subsidiaries/assets that produce them likewise moved into the same Newco LLC vehicle, so T4 and T5 crossed together (gap_45=0). Leadership and board seats were drawn from both sides (GE O&G CEO/CFO installed; BH Chairman retained as Vice Chairman; 6/5 board split) under the new holding company, so T5 and T6 were co-aligned in the closing structure rather than severed (gap_56=0). The ancillary TSA/Intercompany Services, supply, IP and Digital agreements bridged residual GE-parent substrate but did not document a product-without-process or process-without-organization mismatch of the contributed oilfield businesses themselves.
